faqs.q: How does a fanless cooling tower work?
faqs.a: Hot water is spread through the tower and air flows through it by natural draft, carried by the difference in temperature between the warm air inside and the cooler air outside, so no fan is needed.

faqs.q: Where are fanless cooling towers used?
faqs.a: For hot water at 75 to 90 °C from diesel generators, foundries, induction furnaces, air compressors and refrigeration systems.

faqs.q: What are the advantages of a fanless tower?
faqs.a: No fan motor to power, maintain or replace, and no fan noise. The trade-off is that it is larger than a fan-driven tower of the same duty.
